databaseLicense.basis: The dated 2016 NigeriaAIMS v1.3.1 release README expressly publishes the database under ODC-By. AidData separately publishes the selected IATI 2.03 representation; retain both source identities rather than assigning a Level1 release version to that XML.
databaseLicense.originalReleaseCitation: AidData. 2016. NigeriaAIMS_GeocodedResearchRelease_Level1_v1.3.1 geocoded dataset. Williamsburg, VA and Washington, DC: AidData. Accessed on 2026-10-12. http://aiddata.org/research-datasets.
databaseLicense.attributionNotice: Contains data from AidData’s Nigeria AIMS Geocoded Research Release (2016), made available under the Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) v1.0. The selected IATI 2.03 XML was generated on 18 April 2016; its original bytes and immutable source identity are retained beside the derived portfolio, editions and report.

observations: The XML does not declare a Level1 dataset-release version. Its generated-datetime and every observed last-updated-datetime are 2016-04-18T13:57:29.

Both original release datapackages use the inconsistent machine identifier odc-pddl while their license name, license URL and complete README license are ODC-By. Preserve those original fields; use the explicit Attribution notice and terms.

The current AidData landing page labels Version 1.3.2 with publication 2016-04-18 and earlier coverage totals. Its linked v1.3.2 archive instead has a README dated 2017-08-31 and different subset totals. Those release totals are not receiving assertions for the selected XML.
Report counts, financial groups and source coverage must come from the original IATI parser and retained selected editions. Preserve original decimal strings, dates and currency dimensions.

handover.originalXmlChanges: None; retain the selected original bytes unchanged.
handover.derivedWork: Activity, transaction and budget projections, operator selections and reviews, comparisons, and reports are produced by the original IATI workspace and identified by its retained source, plan, build and portfolio records.
